items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: INTERVIEWER: ...Manuel Moneta thinks he made one date. I think Manuel did. It was Manuel Moneta on that date.

ctx.x: Can you remember who else was on that? Who was the piano player? Can you remember? Some people say that Emma Barrett played and Manuel Moneta thinks he made one date. I think Manuel did. It was Manuel Moneta on that date. He thought he made those. He said one date. Yeah, he was. Somehow Emma didn't play that day. I don't know what happened. Those were those three records. We'll play that record and then if you have any remarks to make while the record, you can tell about how we're playing it or any time after.…
